Definition: Darkness — physical darkness and, figuratively, ignorance, evil and separation from the light of God.
BiblicalUsage: Skotia describes the realm people love instead of the light — yet it is a realm God rescues us from, transferring us into His Son's kingdom. John insists the darkness is passing away because the true light is already shining.
TheologicalSignificance: Skotia is real, but it is retreating. No darkness in your story is permanent for those in Christ: He came so that no one who believes need stay in the dark.
